auto_start_world_name.title: World Name
auto_start_world_name.description: World to load automatically when the server starts.

auto_create_and_load_world.title: Auto-create and Load World
auto_create_and_load_world.description: Creates the selected world if it does not exist, then loads it.

auto_create_world_size.title: New World Size
auto_create_world_size.description: Size used when creating a new world. Existing worlds keep their current size.

auto_create_world_seed.title: New World Seed
auto_create_world_seed.description: Seed used when creating a world. Leave empty for a random seed.

password.title: Join Password
password.description: Leave empty to allow joining without a password.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum simultaneous players; Romestead supports up to 8.

enable_cheats.title: Enable Cheats
enable_cheats.description: Allows cheat requests such as spawning items, entities and bosses, changing time and weather, and completing quests. Applies when creating or loading a world; disabled servers reject these requests.

sleep_threshold_ms.title: Low-load CPU Sleep
sleep_threshold_ms.description: Let the server thread sleep under low load to reduce CPU use. Turning this off reduces timing jitter at higher CPU cost. The threshold can be set from 1 to 16.5 milliseconds.

extra_launch_args.title: Extra Launch Arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Optional raw arguments appended to Server.exe for version-specific flags.
